content: Upload/extraction UX: per-file state and real progress rather than one batch bar or indeterminate spinner. Partial success is normal - UI must summarize succeeded/failed/retryable with per-file retry that does not re-upload succeeded files. Drag-and-drop is an enhancement over a manual picker, never the only method. Rejections name reason and fix together. Async jobs need status that survives navigation away and back - restore latest status, never restart or show stale state.
